honesty: ClawQL file-journal only (structural). Companion to the peer outside-write board — fills before_write_sent / after_write_acked / idle_between_steps. during_model_tool_round is peer-specific and skipped. neither + before_write_sent / outside_write stay unknown (intent journaled, no blind resend).

rows.note: SIGKILL before host log on write — request never visible upstream. Intent may already be journaled → neither stays unknown (at most once); keys → keyed resume 0/0/N.
SIGKILL after host log, before return — hardest window (main peer board).
Write completed and journaled; kill on trailing read before its host call → 0 dups / 0 unknown / once.
Kill at start of second read after first call journaled — idle between durable steps; resume replays and finishes write once.
